proposedGuaranteeContract.completion: A fulfilled flag alone never passes. Require the physical evidence list above, exact one-item custody, restored support if applicable, preserved original deadline and immutable paid history. Any failure at or beyond deadline is a blocker, not fulfillment.
proposedGuaranteeContract.auditRestoration: Inverse operations may restore the hypothetical fixture for audit only; they do not rewind gameplay time or remove the committed forward history.
